meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可通过 CDP 控制 Chrome 并复用你已有的登录态：打开网址、等页面加载、执行 JavaScript、提取登录 token 等。首次启动可能关掉你正在用的 Chrome，会先征求同意。
howto.when: 当你要控制浏览器、复用登录态或从页面提取 token 时触发；前提是已装 Chrome、Node.js 20+ 和 agent-browser。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can drive Chrome over CDP and reuse your existing login sessions: open URLs, wait for page load, run JavaScript, take snapshots, extract auth tokens. First launch may close your running Chrome, and asks first.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need browser automation, to reuse existing login sessions, or to pull a token from the page. Requires Chrome, Node.js 20+ and the agent-browser CLI.

say_en.text: Open this URL over CDP and wait for the page to load
Pull the login token from this page's localStorage
